requirements.title: Status is computed from repository artifacts

criteria.text: each stage reports pass, warn or fail
a missing artifact names the command that fixes it

requirements.title: check exits 1 on a failing stage

criteria.text: check exits 1 and prints the blocker
check --stage N asserts one stage; an unknown stage exits 2
running status twice with no change gives the same answer
editing an artifact reopens its stage without any pass command

requirements.title: Sibling tools compose, missing ones are advisory

criteria.text: a missing tool produces a WARN with the install command, not a FAIL

requirements.title: Depth checks flag shallow artifacts without blocking

criteria.text: a vague criterion or a decision without a why produces a WARN
no depth check can fail a stage

requirements.title: The game pack checks world consistency

criteria.text: a missing prerequisite, an unestablished reveal and a prerequisite loop each block
the pack applies only when docs/game exists

requirements.title: guide prints the playbook for the blocking stage

criteria.text: guide with no argument prints the first failing stage's playbook
guide game prints the pack playbook

requirements.title: The work thread survives a context reset

criteria.text: resume prints current.md, the last journal entries and the blocking item
after a release, a missing or stale work thread fails the Sustain stage
